## Importer le dataset généré

```{r load_data, echo=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(DT)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Import CSV
surf_data <- read_csv("carcans_surf_data.csv")
View(surf_data)
```

```{r}
# Nettoyage et préparation
surf_data <- surf_data %>%
  separate(waves_size, into = c("waves_min", "waves_max"), sep = "-", convert = TRUE) %>%
   # Convert wind speed to numeric
  mutate(
    wind_speed = as.numeric(wind_speed),
    
    # Create wave mean
    wave_mean = (waves_min + waves_max) / 2,
    
    # Clean date format if needed
    date = as.Date(date, format = "%A %d %B"),
    
    # Order hour properly
    hour = factor(hour, levels = unique(hour))
  )
```

```{r}
best_moment <- surf_data %>%
  filter(
    wave_mean <= 3.0,
    wind_speed <= 40,
    str_detect(wind_direction, "Nord")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date, hour) %>%
  slice(1)
best_text <- if(nrow(best_moment) == 0) {
  "No optimal moment found"
} else {
  paste(best_moment$date, "@", best_moment$hour)
}
```

```{r}
# --- Dans la partie de préparation des données ---

# 1. Identifier le meilleur jour
best_date <- best_moment$date[1] 

# 2. Créer un jeu de données spécifique pour ce jour
surf_data_day <- surf_data %>%
  filter(date == best_date)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
max_wave <- max(surf_data$wave_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
max_wave
```

```{r}
surf_avg_wave <- surf_data %>%
  group_by(hour) %>%
  summarise(waves_mean = mean(wave_mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
sea_quality <- if(nrow(best_moment) == 0) {
  0
} else {
  score <- 0
  
  if(best_moment$wave_mean <= 3.0) score <- score + 50
  if(best_moment$wind_speed <= 30) score <- score + 30
  if(str_detect(best_moment$wind_direction, "Nord")) score <- score + 20
  
  score
}

```

### Row {data-height="200"}

```{r}
# Utilisation d'un bloc personnalisé pour imiter le style vert du screenshot
valueBox(
  value = paste(best_moment$date, "@", best_moment$hour),
  caption = "Best moment to practice surf",
  icon = "fa-star",
  color = "#3498DB" # Couleur MediumAquamarine
)


```

### Grade of the sea quality

```{r}


gauge(
  sea_quality, 
  min = 0, 
  max = 100, 
  symbol = '%',
  gaugeSectors(danger = c(0, 39), warning = c(40, 79), success = c(80, 100), colors = c("#e84c3d", "#f1c40f", "#2ecc71"))
)
```

### Highest forecasted wave

```{r}
# --- Dans la section Row {data-height=200} ---
valueBox(
  value = paste0(round(max(surf_data_day$wave_mean), 1), " m"),
  caption = paste("Max wave on", best_date),
  icon = "fa-arrows-alt-v",
  color = "#5dade2"
)
```

## Row {data-height="500"}

### Wave size

```{r,height=6}
# --- Dans la section Row {data-height=400} ---
ggplot(surf_data_day, aes(x = hour, y = wave_mean, group = 1)) +                
  geom_area(fill = "#2980b9", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(color = "#2980b9", size = 1) +                
  theme_minimal() +                
  labs(title = paste("Wave size on", best_date), x = "Time", y = "Wave mean (m)") +                
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Wind speed

```{r}
ggplot(surf_data_day, aes(x = hour, y = wind_speed)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#aed6f1") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Wind speed on", best_date), x = "Time", y = "Speed (km/h)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Row {data-height="400"}

### Summarise table

```{r}
surf_table <- surf_data_day %>%
  select(date, hour, waves_min, waves_max, wind_direction)

datatable(
  surf_table,
  options = list(pageLength = 8),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```
